formulation: lyophilized powder for solution for intravenous infusion
moa: recombinant human glucocerebrosidase (velaglucerase alfa) enzyme replacement therapy

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of VPRIV (velaglucerase alfa for injection) for long-term enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) for pediatric and adult patients with type 1 Gaucher disease. (FDA approval letter, NDA 022575, Shire Human Genetic Therapies)

series_start_reason: Shire's Q4 2009 release (8-K 0000950103-10-000434) is the first to print a VPRIV line: $2.5 million from early-access programs before US/EU approval (the Q4 2008 comparative is nil and the release states the Q4 2009 and full-year 2009 figures are equal). A launch quarter is therefore not used as the anchor.
notes: Printed label is 'Vpriv' in the FY2018-FY2019 documents and 'VPRIV' from FY2020. Line is worldwide (the same row carries US, Japan, Europe and Canada, and Growth and Emerging Markets columns from FY2020). launch_quarter is null: the series starts nine years after launch; launch was by Shire in 2010 (see shire_vpriv). Joined with Shire's own worldwide VPRIV line (USD, 2009Q4-2018Q3); Takeda prints JPY from 2019Q1. Each row keeps its issuer's currency. Shire-era notes: USD millions; the 2016 and later releases split the line into U.S. and International columns with a Total, earlier releases print the consolidated line. Annual sums of the four quarters equal the full-year figures printed in the Q4 releases (2010-2017). Dated launch: FDA approved VPRIV on 2010-02-26 (Shire 8-K 0000950103-10-001248, 2010-04-29: 'On February 26, 2010 the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted marketing approval for VPRIV'); the 2009Q4 row precedes it, so launch_quarter is null.
search_log: listed Shire plc (CIK 936402) filings via data.sec.gov submissions and downloaded every 8-K with Item 2.02 from 2010-02 to 2018-11 plus the 2016-2018 10-K/10-Q set; extracted the VPRIV table row from the 3-month net product sales table of each release

Q4 2009 release (2010-02-19) is the earliest with a VPRIV row; the Q3 2009 release (2009-10-30) was not downloaded in this batch, and the 2010-02-19 note states 2009 sales of $2.5 million came from early access programs, all printed in Q4 2009
cross-check: four quarters summed to the full-year figure in each Q4 release for 2010-2017
2018Q4: no Shire release or filing exists on EDGAR after 2018-11-01 other than deregistration forms (25, 15-12B, 15-15D)

reused the Takeda quarterly-results PDF set already downloaded for the sibling batch (takeda.com assets-dam files for FY2018 Q4 through FY2026 Q1: financial statements, data books FY2019, quarterly financial reports FY2020 on) and re-extracted text with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor); every cited URL is the takeda.com copy of the document

for each Takeda fiscal quarter the product-sales analysis page was read: FY2018 Q4 financial statements (Shire 3 months), FY2019 data books (quarterly trend table), FY2020 onward quarterly financial reports (three-month FY(n-1) vs FY(n) table)
EDGAR (Takeda CIK 0001395064) 6-K earnings exhibits were not individually resolved; the takeda.com copies of the same quarterly documents were cited instead
cross-check: for each fiscal year the four quarterly values were summed against the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)
checked Shire 8-K earnings exhibits (CIK 936402, Items 2.02, 2010-2018) and found a VPRIV line every quarter 2009Q4-2018Q3: staged separately as shire_vpriv
Shire 2018Q4 not available: submissions index for CIK 936402 shows Form 25 (2019-01-22) and Form 15 (2019-02-07) and no 10-K or 8-K earnings release after 2018-11-01

unreported_quarters.2018Q4: Ownership change Shire to Takeda; no figure is published. Shire's last earnings release is for Q3 2018 (8-K 0000936402-18-000094, 2018-11-01). Takeda completed the acquisition on 2019-01-08 and Shire filed Form 25 (2019-01-22) and Form 15 (2019-02-07) with no FY2018 10-K or release; the 2018Q4 quarter is not published by either issuer in a citable form. Takeda's continuation (JPY, from 2019Q1) is delivered as takeda_vpriv.

reviewed_anomalies.2019Q1: First Takeda quarter: the line changes from Shire's USD millions to Takeda's JPY millions, so the value as reported steps by the exchange rate, not by sales; the USD-normalised series is continuous.
